back_translation: But you, O Bethlehem Ephrathah, though you are too small to be counted among the clans of Judah, out of you will come forth for Me one who will be ruler in Israel, whose origins are from of old, from ancient days.
Therefore He will give them up until the time when she who is in labor has given birth; then the rest of His brothers will return to join the people of Israel.
He will stand and shepherd His flock in the strength of the LORD, in the majesty of the name of the LORD His God; and they will dwell secure, for now He will be great to the ends of the earth.
And this One will be their peace. When the Assyrian invades our land and tramples our fortresses, we will raise against him seven shepherds and eight leaders of men.
They will rule the land of Assyria with the sword, and the land of Nimrod with the drawn sword. He will deliver us from the Assyrian when he invades our land and tramples our territory.
Then the remnant of Jacob will be in the midst of many peoples like dew from the LORD, like showers on the grass, which do not wait for man or depend on the children of men.

The remnant of Jacob will be among the nations, in the midst of many peoples, like a lion among the beasts of the forest, like a young lion among flocks of sheep, which, when it passes through, tramples and tears to pieces, with no one to rescue.
Your hand will be lifted up over your adversaries, and all your enemies will be cut off.
The LORD declares: In that day I will cut off your horses from among you and destroy your chariots.
I will cut off the cities of your land and tear down all your strongholds.
I will cut off the sorceries from your hand, and you will have no more soothsayers.
I will cut off your carved images and your sacred pillars from among you, and you will no longer bow down to the work of your hands.
I will uproot the Asherah poles from among you and destroy your cities.
And in anger and wrath I will take vengeance on the nations that have not obeyed.
